kind: Head clarification of existing founder accepted-capacity authority
head_words: The standing founder authority already permits cause-recorded NEW-CANDIDATE lineage advancement after accepted work consumes the stage allowance. The prohibition is against resetting a failed candidate or raising/clearing caps/history. If all consumed prior attempts are accepted, money settled, no active/interrupted attempt, and this is the genuine new sec03 merged-card/session input scope, you may use the existing run-utah66–74/168–188 native protocol in your own scratch helper under native lock. Verify standing authority scope/expiry/hash, create an immutable lineage cause receipt linking old lineage/reset, exact accepted outcomes, new scope/input proof, root remediation chain and exact existing founder words; chain reset_ref, update candidate_lineage_id only, preserve every old counter/task/attempt/budget/cap, append jams. Use ordinary GO and existing native claim/rebind API to bind the authorized current config, never direct SQL. Respect bounded maximum TWO such accepted-capacity advances per invocation; no limit changes or general auto-HOLD/nonce recovery.
